risks.title: Credit Rating Downgrades
risks.summary: Any downgrade by rating agencies would directly increase fees and interest rates on the primary credit line, severely impacting the company's liquidity and operating results.
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned in Capital Structure section (middle of report), strong language 'material adverse impact' repeated twice, stable trend but increased complex debt structure (31 Bn$ contractual obligations), credit category heavily weighted for REIT.

risks.title: Debt Refinancing Risk
risks.summary: The company must regularly refinance significant debt (700 M$ in 2026, 2.3 Bn$ in 2027-2028) and depends on access to capital markets. Restricted access or rising rates could jeopardize its ability to fund acquisitions and dividends.
risks.score_rationale: Mid-report positioning (Liquidity and Capital Resources section), massive contractual obligations (31.1 Bn$ total, 4.3 Bn$ due in 2026), implicit language 'depending upon availability and cost of external capital', increasing trend with 91% rise in investing activities.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk Concentration
risks.summary: The company holds debt in Canadian dollars and British pounds, and pre-funds acquisitions in foreign currencies. Exchange rate fluctuations may affect the value of these obligations and consolidated cash flows.
risks.score_rationale: Mid-report positioning (Foreign Currency Translation and contractual obligations sections), explicit exposure in CAD and GBP (2.4 Bn$ in foreign debt), neutral language but observed volatility (129 M$ variation in 2025), emerging trend with Amica transaction pre-funded in CAD.

risks.title: Unconsolidated Put-Call Obligations
risks.summary: The company has entered into put-call agreements on development projects that could obligate it to acquire properties for 375.7 M$, creating a potential off-balance-sheet obligation if certain conditions are met.
risks.score_rationale: Mid-report positioning (Off-Balance Sheet Arrangements section), contingent exposure of 375.7 M$ if conditions triggered, factual language but hidden risk off-balance-sheet, stable trend but significant amount for future acquisitions.

risks.title: Shareholder Dilution from Large-Scale Issuances
risks.summary: The company issued 70.4 million shares in 2024 and has 5.6 Bn$ remaining issuance capacity under its ATM program, creating a risk of significant dilution for existing shareholders.
risks.score_rationale: Mid-report positioning (Capital Structure and Financing Activities sections), documented large-scale issuances (70.4 M shares in 2024, 7.5 Bn$ ATM capacity), neutral language but ongoing dilution, increasing trend with ATM program renewal in October 2025.

risks.title: Increase in Investment Spending
risks.summary: Real estate investment expenditures increased by 91% in 2025, particularly in renovations and redevelopments (675.8 M$), creating increased pressure on cash flows and financing capacity.
risks.score_rationale: Mid-report positioning (Investing Activities section), 91% increase in investing activities (additional 4.99 Bn$), neutral language but increasing trend, renovations and redevelopments up 19%, new development down 47%.

risks.title: Risk of Non-Compliance with Covenants
risks.summary: Debt agreements contain covenants requiring maintenance of financial ratios, minimum net worth, and limiting leverage and acquisitions. Any breach could trigger default clauses.
risks.score_rationale: Mid-report positioning (Capital Structure section), affirmative language 'in compliance in all material respects' but multiple restrictive covenants (financial ratios, minimum net worth, leverage limits), stable trend but complex structure with 31 Bn$ in obligations.
